question: Bohemian Rhapsody has Freddie Mercury reveal his HIV diagnosis to the band before Live Aid, 1985. When was he diagnosed?
answer: About two years after. Jim Hutton, his partner, dates the diagnosis to around April 1987. The film moved it before the concert so the band's triumph could double as a farewell. The real Live Aid performance was a comeback, not a goodbye; the sorrow was added later and set on top.
move: When a real event lands at the perfect dramatic moment, check the date.
ask: Which memory of mine has been rearranged into a better story than what happened?
trap: The same week, as the film lays it out.
reference: Jim Hutton with Tim Wapshott, Mercury and Me, Bloomsbury, 1994
